_COMMENT_structure: MAST has two spectrometer_visible subsystems: D-alpha (XIM, 3 channels) and BES (XBT, 32 channels). Both map to filter_spectrometer/photoelectric_voltage. They are stored as separate IDS occurrences (occurrence 0 = Dalpha, occurrence 1 = BES) in practice, but this single mapping file covers the Dalpha channels. A separate mapping for BES would require a second occurrence.
